title: Ted Owens wills an airliner to crash

tellings.quote: And so he wills the plane ahead of them to crash and it does as a civilian airliner crash.

plain: A man named Ted Owens is said to have willed the plane flying ahead of him and the people he was with to crash, and a civilian airliner did crash. The researcher Jason Jorjani tells the story to Michels without naming a source. If it were true, it would mean a person could bring down an aircraft by will alone.
